variables.$fxv#0:
#cloud-config
# Orchestrator host bootstrap.
# Installs Docker + Azure CLI, then pulls & runs the orchestrator container.
# Container image lives in an ACR that must be provisioned separately and
# granted AcrPull to this VM's managed identity.

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true

packages:
  - ca-certificates
  - curl
  - gnupg
  - lsb-release
  - jq

runcmd:
  # Docker Engine
  - install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
  - curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
  - chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
  - echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null
  - apt-get update
  - apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
  - systemctl enable --now docker

  # Azure CLI (Commercial cloud - pilot only)
  - curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | bash
  - az cloud set --name AzureCloud

  # Placeholder: fetch settings via Instance Metadata Service + Key Vault
  # and start the orchestrator container. Replace ACR + image after build.

  # ACR_LOGIN_SERVER=<yourregistry>.azurecr.io
  # IMAGE=$ACR_LOGIN_SERVER/faq-orchestrator:latest
